QuestInfo.name: A Second Gift for the Dragon Master
QuestInfo.0: When you reach Lvl. 50, #p9010010# starts talking to you...
QuestInfo.1: #b#p9010010##k congratulates you for reaching Lv. 50 and asks that you come see her so that she can give you a scroll that can be used.
QuestInfo.2: You received a scroll from #p9010010#. She says she will give you another scroll if you reach Lv. 60 by #bMay 5#k.

0.0: Wow! Evan, you've already reached Lv. 50? That was much faster than I expected! In that case, let me give you the scroll that can be used on the Dragon Glasses as I promised before. Be sure to come see me!
0.1: You do know where I am right? Just come to a town. I'm always here.

no.0: Hmm. You're not implying that you don't like the gift that I, #p9010010#, prepared for you, right?

1.0: You've come! My, you really have grown! And the Dragon also looks nothing like it used to. Although, it's still really cute...
1.1: Now, let me give you the gift that I've prepared. It's a scroll that can only be used on a Dragon Glasses. I made it myself, of course.

yes.0: Hehehe... Acutally, this isn't #bthe end#k of my scrolls. I'm never cheap with my gifts! I can give it to you now, but that'd be no fun. Get to #bLv. 60 before May 5#k this time. I will give you another scroll that you can use on the #t1022097#.
